name: Chapter Revision
description: Declarative chapter revision template. Workflow execution is not implemented and must not modify novel data.

stages.title: Draft
stages.intent: Establish the chapter's current job, viewpoint, and exit question.

stages.title: Structure Review
stages.intent: Check scene order, goal-conflict-turn, and ornamental beats.

stages.title: Character Motivation Review
stages.intent: Verify action follows want, fear, and available knowledge.

stages.title: Continuity Review
stages.intent: Flag contradictions with established facts. Do not silently rewrite canon.

stages.title: Pacing Review
stages.intent: Mark stalls, rushes, and missing sequel space.

stages.title: Dialogue Review
stages.intent: Test voice distinction, subtext, and load-bearing turns.

stages.title: Prose Polish
stages.intent: Apply tighten and clarity notes without changing plot facts.

stages.title: Final QC
stages.intent: Human review of residual risks before any future application.
